newsitem.title: USA: Converse signs Rodman to promote shoes.
newsitem.headline: Converse signs Rodman to promote shoes.

text.p: Converse Inc said it signed Chicago Bulls star Dennis Rodman to a multi-year contract and will name a new basketball shoe after him.

Rodman will appear in commercials advertising Converse's black, white and crimson-colored All Star Springfield shoes, which he will wear on court until the playoffs. During the playoffs, Converse will launch a new Rodman shoe.
"We look forward to Dennis' imminent return to the NBA and the world champion Chicago Bulls," Converse senior vice president of marketing James Solomon said in a release.

Rodman was suspended for at least 11 games, fined $25,000 and ordered to see a counseller for kicking a courtside cameraman in Minneapolis two weeks ago. Rodman agreed to pay the cameraman $200,000 in an out-of-court settlement.
The Springfield shoe has a suggested retail price of $75.
